caption: The drawing depicts a single tool consisting of a wooden handle and a broad metal blade. The handle is cylindrical, medium brown in color, and slightly angled. The blade is an elongated oval with a curved edge, appearing dull gray and reddish-brown with signs of rust or wear. Two dark metallic brackets are affixed to the blade, extending upward in an arch and attaching to the handle, helping to secure it firmly. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or features. The tool is oriented at an angle, and the artwork uses realistic color shading to highlight the wooden and metallic textures.
title: Amana Baker's Hoe
